section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in 228 Black college women (M age = 19.89 years). The study investigated the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, and examined convergent and divergent validity through correlations with appearance evaluation, self-esteem, beauty ideal internalization, eating disordered behavior, and teasing. Results supported the construct validity and unidimensional factor structure of the BAS for use with Black college women.
